description: IDOR Eats is a food delivery application running on Apache 2.4.41 (Ubuntu) at http://localhost:8080. The application features user authentication, restaurant search, and order management. Contains multiple API endpoints and user-facing pages. The name "IDOR Eats" suggests the application is designed to demonstrate Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerabilities for security testing/training.

endpoints: /profile.php - User profile (requires authentication, redirects to login)
/api/search_restaurants.php - Search restaurants API (GET with query parameter)

notes: Application uses PHP sessions for authentication. Directory listing is enabled on /api/ and /static/ directories. The application name and structure suggest this is a deliberately vulnerable application designed for security training/testing with IDOR vulnerabilities.
